title: Simulation-Driven Evolutionary Motion Parameterization for Contact-Rich Granular Scooping with a Soft Conical Robotic Hand
summary: Tool-based scooping is vital in robot-assisted tasks, enabling interaction with objects of varying sizes, shapes, and material states. Recent studies have shown that flexible, reconfigurable soft robotic end-effectors can adapt their shape to maintain consistent contact with container surfaces during scooping, improving efficiency compared to rigid tools. These soft tools can adjust to varying container sizes and materials without requiring complex sensing or control. However, the inherent compliance and complex deformation behavior of soft robotics introduce significant control complexity that limits practical applications. To address this challenge, this paper presents the development of a physics-based simulation model of a deformable soft conical robotic hand that captures its passive reconfiguration dynamics and enables systematic trajectory optimization for scooping tasks. We propose a novel physics-based simulation approach that accurately models the soft tool's morphing behavior from flat sheets to adaptive conical structures, combined with an evolutionary strategy framework that automatically optimizes scooping trajectories without manual parameter tuning. We validate the optimized trajectories through both simulation and real-robot experiments. The results demonstrate strong generalization and successfully address a range of challenging tasks previously beyond the reach of existing approaches. Videos of our experiments are available online: https://sites.google.com/view/scoopsh
summary_zh: 基于工具的舀取在机器人辅助任务中至关重要，能够与不同尺寸、形状和物态的物体进行交互。最近的研究表明，柔性可重构的软体机器人末端执行器能够在舀取过程中自适应地调整形状，以保持与容器表面的持续接触，与刚性工具相比提高了效率。这些软体工具能够适应不同的容器尺寸和材质，无需复杂的传感或控制。然而，软体机器人固有的柔顺性和复杂的变形行为带来了显著的控制复杂性，限制了实际应用。为应对这一挑战，本文提出开发一种基于物理的可变形软体锥形机器人手仿真模型，该模型能够捕捉其被动重构动力学特性，并实现舀取任务的系统化轨迹优化。我们提出了一种新颖的基于物理的仿真方法，能够准确模拟软体工具从平面薄片到自适应锥形结构的形变行为，并结合进化策略框架实现舀取轨迹的自动优化，无需手动参数调整。我们通过仿真和真实机器人实验验证了优化后的轨迹。结果表明，该方法具有很强的泛化能力，并成功解决了以往方法无法处理的一系列具有挑战性的任务。实验视频可在以下网址查看：https://sites.google.com/view/scoopsh

title: Bilinear Model Predictive Control Framework of the OncoReach, a Tendon-Driven Steerable Stylet for Brachytherapy
summary: Steerable needles have the potential to improve interstitial brachytherapy by enabling curved trajectories that avoid sensitive anatomical structures. However, existing modeling and control approaches are primarily developed for custom needle designs and are not directly applicable to stylets compatible with commercially available clinical needles. This paper presents a bilinear model predictive control (MPC) framework for a tendon-driven steerable stylet integrated with a standard brachytherapy needle. \textcolor{black}{A geometric bilinear model is formulated with three virtual inputs (an insertion speed and two bending rates) which are mapped to physically realizable inputs consisting of the insertion speed and the associated tendon tensions.} The approach is validated through simulations and physical insertion experiments in tissue-mimicking phantom material using image-based tip tracking. While open-loop model validation yielded estimation errors below $2$~mm, corresponding to $3\%$ of the inserted needle length, and closed-loop fixed-target tracking achieved an error as low as $1.45$~mm, corresponding to $1.7\%$ of the inserted length, experiments showed larger position errors in certain bending directions, reaching $8.3$~mm, or $7.8\%$ of the inserted length. Overall, the results demonstrate the feasibility of fixed-target positioning and moving-target trajectory tracking for clinically compatible steerable brachytherapy systems, while highlighting necessary areas for future improvements in calibration and sensing.
tldr: A bilinear model predictive control framework is proposed for a tendon‑driven steerable stylet that couples with a standard brachytherapy needle, enabling curved insertion trajectories; the approach is validated in simulation and tissue‑mimicking phantom experiments, achieving sub‑centimeter tracking errors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于标准近距离治疗针的腱驱动可弯曲尖端的二次模型预测控制框架，通过仿真和仿体实验验证了其在亚厘米范围内实现曲线插入轨迹的可行性。
summary_zh: 可转向针有可能通过实现能够避开敏感解剖结构的弯曲轨迹来改善近距离组织间放疗。然而，现有的建模和控制方法主要是针对定制针头设计的，并不直接适用于与临床商用针头兼容的套管。本文提出了一种用于集成标准近距离放疗针的肌腱驱动可转向套管的双线性模型预测控制（MPC）框架。建立了几何双linear模型，包含三个虚拟输入（插入速度和两个弯曲速率），这些虚拟输入被映射到由插入速度和相关的肌腱张力组成的物理可实现输入。该方法通过使用基于图像的尖端跟踪在仿组织体模材料中进行仿真和物理插入实验来验证。开环模型验证得到的估计误差低于2 mm，相当于插入针长度的3%，闭环固定目标跟踪实现的误差低至1.45 mm，相当于插入长度的1.7%，然而实验表明在某些弯曲方向上存在更大的位置误差，达到8.3 mm或插入长度的7.8%。总体而言，研究结果表明临床兼容的可转向近距离放疗系统进行固定目标定位和移动目标轨迹跟踪是可行的，同时指出了未来在标定和传感方面需要改进的领域。

title: Control Architecture and experimental validation of a Novel Surgical Robotic Instrument
summary: Minimally invasive surgery (MIS) reduces patient trauma and shortens recovery time; however, conventional laparoscopic instruments remain constrained by limited range of movements. This work presents the control architecture of a 4-DOF flexible laparoscopic instrument integrating distal bending, independent distal head rotation, shaft rotation, and a gripper, while maintaining a 10 mm diameter compatible with standard trocars. The actuation unit and SpaceMouse teleoperation are implemented on Raspberry Pi 5 with Motoron controllers. An analytical scissor-linkage model is derived and parameterized. The predicted jaw opening corresponds to CAD measurements (MAE 0.13{\textdegree}) and OptiTrack motion capture (MAE 1.43{\textdegree}). Integration with the ATHENA parallel robot is validated through a simulated pancreatic surgery procedure.
tldr: This paper presents a 4-DOF flexible laparoscopic instrument with distal bending, rotation, and gripper capabilities, controlled via Raspberry Pi 5 and validated through CAD and motion capture experiments integrated with a parallel robot for simulated pancreatic surgery.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种4自由度柔性腹腔镜器械，具有末端弯曲、旋转和夹持器功能，采用树莓派5控制，并通过CAD和运动捕捉实验验证，集成到并联机器人中进行了模拟胰腺手术验证。
summary_zh:
摘要：
微创手术（MIS）可减少患者创伤并缩短恢复时间；然而，传统腹腔镜器械仍受限于运动范围有限。本研究提出了一种4自由度柔性腹腔镜器械的控制架构，该器械集成远端弯曲、独立远端头部旋转、轴旋转和夹爪功能，同时保持10 mm直径以兼容标准 trocar。致动单元和SpaceMouse遥操作系统在配备Motoron控制器的Raspberry Pi 5上实现。推导并参数化了解析剪刀连杆模型。预测的钳口开度与CAD测量结果一致（平均绝对误差0.13°），与OptiTrack运动捕捉结果相符（平均绝对误差1.43°）。通过模拟胰腺手术流程验证了与ATHENA并联机器人的集成效果。
